FAQ

Ask us anything.

50 answers on features, security, pricing and more — pick a topic, then ask our HR assistant.

SublimeHR is a cloud-based HR and workforce management platform. It brings employee records, attendance, leave, shift scheduling, payroll, reports and employee self-service into one system, with separate Admin and Employee panels and a native mobile app.
Growing businesses and enterprises across manufacturing, healthcare, IT, education, hospitality, retail, logistics, professional services and construction, anywhere you manage office, remote, hybrid, shift-based or field teams.
Most customers go live in days, not months. Our team handles setup and data migration, then trains your admins and employees.
Yes. You can start a free trial on the Starter plan or book a personalized 30-minute demo with our team. No credit card is required.
Yes. Every plan includes onboarding training. Enterprise plans include dedicated success managers and role-based training programs.
SublimeHR integrates with fingerprint, RFID card and facial-recognition attendance devices. Share your device make and model and we'll confirm compatibility.
Yes. Employees can punch in from the web or mobile app with camera and GPS verification, and beacon-based authorization for on-site validation.
Missing or mismatched clock-in/out pairs are flagged automatically. Employees raise regularization requests and managers approve them through a punch approval workflow.
Yes. Attendance types are fully configurable, along with late-coming and missed clock-in tolerance rules.
Yes. Rounding rules for clock-in/out times are fully configurable to match your policy.
Yes. Accruals, attendance-based accrual, per-employee overrides, tolerance and weekend policies are all configurable without code.
Yes. HR can apply leave on behalf of any employee, with the same approval and balance checks.
You define the approval chain and requests route automatically from one approver to the next, with notifications at every step.
Yes. Holiday and leave calendars show who is away across teams so you can prevent understaffing.
Yes. Configure branch-level holiday lists and policies to match local statutory requirements.
Yes. Attendance, leave, late-coming and penalties flow directly into payroll calculations, so there is no re-keying.
Yes. Configure payroll heads, custom allowances and deductions, and design your own salary slip template.
Yes. Employees download monthly payslips as PDFs from the portal or mobile app.
Yes. The Daily Salary Report gives finance a day-by-day breakdown of payroll cost.
Yes. Employees can request advances, managers can approve, and repayments schedule automatically.
13 built-in report types: Event Sheet, Timesheet, Attendance, Attendance Comparison, Exception, Punch Approval, Who Is Here, Daily Clock In/Out, Penalty, Daily Salary, Visitor Timesheet, Biometrics/Registration and Late Coming.
Yes. The admin dashboard is built from widgets you can arrange, and Enterprise customers can get role-specific custom dashboards.
Yes. Report data can be exported for spreadsheets, finance and audit tools.
Yes. Critical modules — including policy and status changes — keep a full audit trail.
Yes. Role-based access ensures every leader sees exactly the data they need, and nothing more.
Yes. SublimeHR runs on secure cloud infrastructure with MFA, role-based access control, tenant isolation and audit trails.
Yes. MFA / OTP authentication is supported, and login can use email, username or employee code.
Roles carry View / Add / Edit / Delete rights per feature, with user-level permission overrides.
Yes. Changes to policies, statuses and other critical records are logged with who changed what and when.
Yes. Multi-tenant architecture with subdomain isolation keeps each customer's data logically separated.
Yes. Most needs are handled through configuration. For truly unique workflows, our team builds custom modules, approvals, payroll rules and integrations.
It depends on scope. After discovery you receive a solution design with a timeline and fixed pricing, and you see sprint demos every two weeks.
Ownership terms are agreed in your custom development contract, discuss your requirements with our solutions team.
Yes. We connect legacy ERPs, accounting systems, LMS and internal tools to any REST-based system.
Use the Custom Development request form or book a consultation with our solutions team.
Per active user per month: Starter is $4, Professional is $8, and Enterprise is custom-priced. You pay only for active employees.
Standard plans include free onboarding and data migration. Enterprise projects with custom development are quoted separately.
Yes. You can upgrade or change plans as your team grows.
Yes. Talk to our sales team about annual billing options.
Monthly plans are month-to-month. Annual plans run for 12 months with auto-renewal.
Yes. White-glove data migration from spreadsheets or your existing HR system is included in onboarding.
Professional plans include priority support. Enterprise plans include a dedicated success manager.
Starter and Professional customers get support during business hours. Enterprise customers get 24/7 premium support.
Yes. Every implementation comes with documentation and training material for admins and employees.
Yes. Every implementation includes admin and end-user training. Additional workshops are available on demand.
Yes. A native mobile app covers punch-in, leave, approvals, WFH requests and admin access, with permissions controlled from the web admin.
Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, biometric devices, QuickBooks, Tally, SAP, Oracle, Okta / SAML SSO, and any system via REST API.
Yes. SSO / SAML authentication is available on the Enterprise plan.
Yes. A documented REST API is available for custom integrations.
